title: AppTabMember - Data API
description: Represents the list of tabs for each of the available apps. This object is available in API version 43.0 and later.

AppDefinitionId.description: The ID of the AppDefinition object. This is a relationship field.

DurableId.description: A unique virtual Salesforce ID for the color.

SortOrder.description: The number used to sort this tab in the application.

TabDefinitionId.description: The ID of the TabDefinition object. This is a relationship field.

WorkspaceDriverField.description: Refers to the workspace mapping in the CustomApplication Metadata API object.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="AppTabMember">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="AppDefinition" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:AppDefinition"/>
        <element name="AppDefinitionId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="DurableId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="SortOrder" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="TabDefinition" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:TabDefinition"/>
        <element name="TabDefinitionId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="WorkspaceDriverField" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
